# Trade Charts

> Free US field reference for HVAC/R, electrical, gas piping and welding: refrigerant PT charts, superheat/subcooling, NEC conduit fill, ampacity, voltage drop and box fill, IFGC gas pipe sizing, and equipment age by serial number. Every value comes from a cited source (NEC, IFGC, manufacturer and NIST/CoolProp data) and is checked by automated tests.

All calculators run in the browser; no sign-up. Reference only: verify with the adopted code and manufacturer literature.

## PT Charts

- [Refrigerant PT Charts: 32 Pressure-Temperature Tables](https://mydevspace2.github.io/trade-charts/pt-chart/): Free refrigerant PT charts for R-454B, R-32, R-410A, R-22, R-134a, R-404A, R-448A and 25 more. Bubble/dew, °F/°C, psig/kPa, printable.

## HVAC Calcs

- [HVAC Calculators: Superheat, Subcooling, Target SH](https://mydevspace2.github.io/trade-charts/hvac-calculators/): Free HVAC field calculators: superheat, subcooling and target superheat for 32 refrigerants, plus refrigerant comparisons. Fast, no sign-up.
- [Subcooling Calculator: Liquid Pressure to Subcool (°F/°C)](https://mydevspace2.github.io/trade-charts/subcooling-calculator/): Free subcooling calculator for R-410A, R-454B, R-32, R-22 and 28 more. Uses the bubble point for blends. Enter liquid pressure and line temperature.
- [Superheat Calculator: R-410A, R-454B, R-32, R-22 & More](https://mydevspace2.github.io/trade-charts/superheat-calculator/): Free superheat calculator for 32 refrigerants. Enter suction pressure and line temperature; uses dew point for blends. °F/°C and psig/kPa.
- [Target Superheat Calculator for Fixed-Orifice A/C](https://mydevspace2.github.io/trade-charts/target-superheat-calculator/): Target superheat from indoor wet bulb and outdoor dry bulb for piston/fixed-orifice systems, with a quick table and a check against your measured superheat.
